name: cloud-native-event-driven-scaling
description: Use when the user asks about KEDA, ScaledObject, ScaledJob, TriggerAuthentication, scale to zero, scaling pods on queue length, Kafka consumer lag or SQS depth autoscaling on Kubernetes. Produces KEDA configs with flapping control and long-running job handling. Not for CPU/memory HPA, VPA or node autoscaling (use devops-kubernetes-autoscaling).
